sbe:messageSchema.description: phixeron frame layer: the Unsequenced/Sequenced envelope pair

composite.name: messageHeader
composite.description: Template and schema identification for every message on the wire

composite.name: unsequencedHeader
composite.description: Frame header on cluster ingress: who produced this frame, over which connection and cluster session, and what its payload is

type.name: sourceId
type.description: Identifies the producer. Rostered gateways use their gatewaySourceId; -1 is reserved for the cluster itself and is illegal here

type.name: connectionId
type.description: The producer's own connection id; unique within one producer process, never across processes

type.name: sessionId
type.description: Aeron Cluster session id. Advisory on ingress — the sequencer overwrites it with the session the frame actually arrived on

type.name: payloadId
type.description: Names the payload's decoder namespace and encoding; 1 is core, 0 is invalid on the wire

composite.name: sequencedHeader
composite.description: Frame header on the tap: the ingress header verbatim, plus the sequencer's stamp

type.name: sourceId
type.description: Copied verbatim from ingress; -1 marks a frame the cluster synthesized (F-4)

type.name: connectionId
type.description: Copied verbatim from ingress; -1 on a synthesized frame

type.name: sessionId
type.description: The true Aeron Cluster session id the frame arrived on; -1 on a synthesized frame

type.name: globalSeqNo
type.description: Cluster-wide monotone sequence number, starting at 1, one per emitted frame, never reused and never gapped (S-4)

type.name: timestamp
type.description: Raft consensus time (ms since epoch) at commit — never a node's local clock (S-3)

type.name: correlationId
type.description: clusterctl-assigned id, echoed in the frame so the tool matches its own marker

type.name: gatewayName
type.description: Launch-time gateway identity (PHIXERON_*_GATEWAY_NAME); byte[0]==0x00 signals absent

type.name: protocolName
type.description: Label SbeLogPrinter prints for a payload it cannot decode; byte[0]==0x00 signals absent

sbe:message.name: Unsequenced
sbe:message.description: One frame on cluster ingress, awaiting a globalSeqNo. The sequencer admits it under §9.2 and republishes it as Sequenced, or rejects it and emits nothing at all

data.name: payload
data.description: The payload named by header.payloadId, opaque here and copied byte-identical onto the tap. Bounded by MAX_PAYLOAD_LENGTH (§12); MAY be empty

sbe:message.name: Sequenced
sbe:message.description: One frame on the node tap: an admitted ingress frame, or one the cluster synthesized on its own initiative. The only template the recording holds

data.name: payload
data.description: The payload named by header.payloadId, byte-identical to the ingress frame's where there was one

sbe:message.name: ClientConnected
sbe:message.description: A connection opened at a gateway. connectionData carries whatever identity that gateway's connections have — opaque to core, encoded by the producer named by header.sourceId, and MAY be empty

sbe:message.name: ClientDisconnected
sbe:message.description: A connection closed at a gateway. No fields: header.connectionId names a connection every consumer already saw connect, so there is nothing to add

sbe:message.name: LeadershipChanged
sbe:message.description: A new Aeron Cluster leadership term began. Synthesized once per term, de-duplicated on newLeaderMemberId; illegal on ingress

field.name: newLeaderMemberId
field.description: Aeron Cluster memberId of the node that is leader from this globalSeqNo onward

sbe:message.name: ClusterStarted
sbe:message.description: Operator marker recording that the cluster is up and open for the day; published by clusterctl once an elected leader exists

sbe:message.name: ClusterStopped
sbe:message.description: Operator marker recording an orderly shutdown; the last business event in the log

sbe:message.name: ClusterHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: The cluster clock, synthesized at 1 Hz off a cluster timer. No fields: the frame's consensus timestamp and globalSeqNo are the whole message, which makes this the cheapest frame in the system. Illegal on ingress

sbe:message.name: GatewayRegistered
sbe:message.description: One roster row, published by clusterctl load-topology. remaining=0 marks the last row and is the completeness edge the bootstrap GatewayActives are synthesized behind

field.name: remaining
field.description: Roster rows still to come after this one; 0 = last

field.name: gatewayId
field.description: The row's own identity, unique across the roster; what a GatewayActive names

field.name: gatewaySourceId
field.description: The logical gateway this row belongs to, shared by every instance of it; the value header.sourceId is matched against

field.name: preferenceRank
field.description: 0 = designated primary (exactly one per gatewaySourceId); 1,2… = standbys

sbe:message.name: GatewayActive
sbe:message.description: Designates one gateway instance as its logical gateway's active one. Four producers: clusterctl activate on ingress, and the sequencer at bootstrap, on session close and on activation timeout

sbe:message.name: GatewayStarted
sbe:message.description: A gateway instance activated. Binds its cluster session to this gatewayId, and releases every connection still open under its gatewaySourceId

field.name: firstConnectionId
field.description: Where this instance resumes allocating connectionIds, chosen past the highest its own replay held

sbe:message.name: PayloadIdRegistered
sbe:message.description: One row of the topology file's protocols section: what a shared payloadId is called in this deployment. Labeling only — the sequencer never decodes it and registration gates nothing

field.name: protocolVersion
field.description: Which revision the deployment runs; printed beside the name and checked by nothing
